input.change_text: \`/multitask\` is now available in the editor for running async subagents to parallelize your requests instead of adding them to the queue.

output.subject: `/multitask` slash command parallelizes requests via async subagents
output.action_text: Use `/multitask` in the cursor editor to dispatch parallel async subagents instead of queuing requests. Opt-in; default queuing behavior unchanged for prompts that don't invoke the command.
